findings.highlight: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.
findings.evidenceJa: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
findings.governingReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

findings.highlight: I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.
findings.evidenceJa: この気だるさは眠りが浅かったせいだろう。
findings.governingReading: He supposes sluggishness from shallow/light sleep.
findings.explanation: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.
